DECODE(V.BUYER, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS CARD_YN --신용카드 사용고객사 , NVL(W.DEPT_FIX, 'N') AS DEPT_FIX --요청부서 조건 고정 , NVL(W.PR_USER_FIX, 'N') AS PR_USER_FIX --발주자로 조건 고정 , NVL(W.PO_USER_FIX, 'N') AS PO_USER_FIX --요청자로 조건 고정 , DECODE(A.BUYER, NULL, NULL, A.BTN_TEXT) AS EXTR_REPORT_BTN --추가리포트버튼 , DECODE(A.BUYER, NULL, NULL, A.REPORT_ID) AS EXTR_REPORT_ID --추가리포트아이디 , DECODE(B.BUYER, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS CLSD_DNLD_YN --[마감다운로드](버튼) 기능 FROM ( SELECT #{com_code} AS BUYER --SESSION COMCODE FROM DUAL ) X , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000004) 그리드 출력 초기 rowcount 100 (default rowcount 10) */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER, B.COL01_DATA AS ROW_CNT FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000004' /* SLOGIC-END */ ) Y , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000005) 발주서 양식이 다름 ==팝업에 적용 하겠음 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000005' /* SLOGIC-END */ ) Z , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P06-0000043) 신용카드사용 코객사 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE BUYER FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000043' --<-- P07-0000006 : ID 대체 /* SLOGIC-END */ ) V , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000008) 조회조건 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER , B.COL01_DATA AS DEPT_FIX , B.COL02_DATA AS PR_USER_FIX , B.COL03_DATA AS PO_USER_FIX FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000008' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{user_id} AND USER_TYPE = 'A') /* SLOGIC-END */ ) W , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000016) 추가리포트버튼 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER , B.COL01_DATA AS BTN_TEXT , B.COL02_DATA AS REPORT_ID , B.COL03_DATA AS REPORT_URL FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000016' /* SLOGIC-END */ ) A , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000017) 마감다운로드 기능 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE AS BUYER FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000017' /* SLOGIC-END */ ) B WHERE X.BUYER = Y.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = Z.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = V.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = W.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = A.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = B.BUYER(+)
mapper.update: /*updateBuyerWmGrWarehousingSolbLisPodt*/ UPDATE ICOMPODT PO SET PO.GR_QTY = NVL(PO.GR_QTY,0) - NVL( ${gr_qty} , 0) WHERE PO.BUYER = #{com_code} AND (PO.PO_NO, PO.PO_SEQ) IN (SELECT GR.PO_NO, GR.PO_SEQ FROM ICOMGRDT GR WHERE PO.BUYER = GR.BUYER AND GR.GR_NO = #{gr_no} AND GR.GR_SEQ = #{gr_seq})
mapper.select: /*selectBuyerWmGrWarehousingSolbLisProcessInfo*/ SELECT HD.PROCESS_TYPE , WMS.WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMPODT PO, ICOMPOHD HD, WMSIVDT WMS WHERE PO.BUYER = #{com_code} AND (PO.PO_NO, PO.PO_SEQ) IN (SELECT GR.PO_NO, GR.PO_SEQ FROM ICOMGRDT GR WHERE PO.BUYER = GR.BUYER AND GR.GR_NO = #{gr_no} AND GR.GR_SEQ = #{gr_seq}) AND PO.BUYER = HD.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = HD.PO_NO AND PO.BUYER = WMS.BUYER(+) AND PO.PO_NO = WMS.PO_NO(+) AND PO.PO_SEQ = WMS.PO_SEQ(+) AND WMS.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND PO.STATUS <> 'D' AND HD.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: /*updateBuyerWmGrWarehousingSolbLisWmsIvdt1*/ UPDATE WMSIVDT A SET A.BUYER_GR_QTY = 0 , A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = #{com_code} AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{warehouse_code} AND A.SELLER = 'KRKORE0001' AND (A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ) IN (SELECT GR.PO_NO, GR.PO_SEQ FROM ICOMGRDT GR WHERE A.BUYER = GR.BUYER AND GR.GR_NO = #{gr_no} AND GR.GR_SEQ = #{gr_seq}) AND A.STATUS != 'D'

/*updateBuyerWmGrWarehousingSolbLisWmsIvdt2*/ UPDATE WMSIVDT A SET A.BUYER_GR_QTY = 0 , A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = #{com_code} AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{warehouse_code} AND A.SELLER = 'KRKORE0001' AND (A.INV_NO, A.INV_SEQ) IN (SELECT GR.INV_NO, GR.INV_SEQ FROM ICOMGRDT GR WHERE A.BUYER = GR.BUYER AND GR.GR_NO = #{gr_no} AND GR.GR_SEQ = #{gr_seq}) AND A.STATUS != 'D'
mapper.select: /* selectBuyerWmGrWarehousingSolbLockCheck */ SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) AS YN_FLAG FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE 1=1 AND TYPE = 'NOGR' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{com_code} AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = (SELECT SUBSTR(GR_DATE, 0, 6) FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE BUYER = #{com_code} AND GR_NO = #{gr_no} AND GR_SEQ = #{gr_seq} AND STATUS <> 'D')
